Purpose: Explain definitions, policy states, public documentation, local status
Permitted inputs: Public or local non-sensitive metadata; canonical registry terms
Permitted outputs: Plain-language explanation, status summary, accessible help text
Must not do: Make recommendations, score people, access sensitive data, change state

Purpose: Compute deterministic metrics, validate schemas, detect gaps, generate uncertainty summaries
Permitted inputs: Purpose-compatible minimized evidence, local sensor summaries, model parameters, public data, structured community evidence
Permitted outputs: Calculations, estimates, error states, anomaly flags, evidence-quality summaries
Must not do: Authorize action, deny services, infer protected attributes, hide uncertainty

Purpose: Produce bounded planning or maintenance recommendations
Permitted inputs: Compatible evidence, uncertainty, policy constraints, local context
Permitted outputs: Advisory recommendation, options, remediation suggestions, review package
Must not do: Make binding decision, control hardware, change entitlement, override gates

Purpose: Prepare policy updates, threshold proposals, migration reports, scenario tests
Permitted inputs: Versioned policy artifacts, schemas, synthetic fixtures, aggregated non-sensitive conformance history
Permitted outputs: Candidate policy artifact, migration plan, impact analysis, test matrix
Must not do: Promote policy, silently lower protections, alter active policy

Purpose: Organize evidence and accessible materials for human review
Permitted inputs: Minimum necessary local records, protected references, receipt commitments
Permitted outputs: Review packet, conflict summary, provenance map, accessible explanation, appeal materials
Must not do: Resolve contested records, issue final finding, expose raw protected records

Purpose: Detect local safety-state change and recommend safe-mode review
Permitted inputs: Non-identifying sensor state, alignment state, maintenance state, ASMI inputs
Must not do: Physical actuation, remote device control, person tracking

Purpose: Present a bounded local state to a qualified controller
Permitted inputs: Explicit controller state, local policy state, verified safety envelope
Permitted outputs: Non-authoritative state token for a separately governed controller
Must not do: Execute public-space actuation, service denial, access restriction, autonomous escalation
